design:
## Design tests

The cast of builder 0.43.0 and revision 41 were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v043.md`, six pictures and one rebuilt, seven readers). Five placed on their first, second or fourth seed, and one on its fifth:
- **The trip and the reading dog,** in two pictures, were kept apart. The trip read in both, and the dog lying over its paper read as reading in both, the contradiction named: "looking down at it as if it is reading the paper. That is odd, because dogs can't read". Each reader also offered "pawing at" the paper.
- **The begging dog at 45,** its mouth closed, begged "as if begging for her ice cream".
- **The goat** was tethered in both of its pictures. In a back garden it was still "a little unusual, but not impossible".
- **The two women:** no reader called either a girl. The woman in purple, half turned with a camera, was once "a person with long dark hair", her gender "not certain".
- **The stalking cat:** on the ground in profile, its face was "right up against" the bird, "it already has the bird at its mouth". Revision 41 now keeps a gap, and the rebuilt picture read "about to pounce on the bird".
intro: The fortieth screen read 94 pictures, the set's 21 and 73 probes, with twelve readers and four scorers: 977 of 1003 scored items had full marks, and one was misread. 62 of 64 templates pass the gate. `dog_reading` falls, and with it the one misread: the dog lying over its paper, which read as reading on the bench and in the design tests, read in whole pictures as a dog "lying on an open newspaper", pawing at it or tearing it. `dog_wants_walk` falls on one reader who took the lead in the dog's mouth for one on its collar. The trip, v0.42's failure, reads 1.00 in five pictures with the reading dog kept away. The woman in yellow was "a woman" in 15 of her 16 pictures and the woman in purple in 16 of her 18, where v0.42 had them "girl" in six of 14 and about ten of 23.
redrawn: `dog_reading`, lying down, is at 0.533, its paper never standing by itself and the dog never a person, but read as lying on the paper. `about_to_trip` reads 1.00 in five pictures, the reading dog away from it. `dog_begs`, its mouth closed, reads 1.00 in four pictures, at 90 and 45. `goat_grazing` reads 1.00 in six pictures, tethered in all six, unusual in four and twice, from behind, possibly a sheep. `cat_stalks_bird`, in profile only, reads 1.00. `plant_flowers` and `photo`, probed five times each, read 1.00 and 0.90. `dog_wants_walk`, not redrawn, falls at 0.833. No reader called the dogs' legs stiff or the cat's tangled, or mentioned a shoe.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (42 in three, 8 in four, 6 in five, 5 in six, 1 in seven, 1 in nine and 1 in nineteen), and 62 of 64 pass. `dog_reading` falls at 0.533 with the misread, in five pictures; `dog_wants_walk` at 0.833, on two half marks in one of its three pictures, as in v0.42 (0.917) on a half mark of the same kind. The lowest that pass are `photo` (0.90) and `square_wheel` (0.944). Per angle (`vision/v043/gate_yaw.json`), all 23 (template, angle) pairs pass at 1.00, v0.42's 25 less the stalking cat's two now that it is drawn only in profile. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: Every cell of the set placed under revision 41: tiers 1 to 3 on v0.42's base seeds, but the tier-3 playground, which placed only on a fresh seed list after 13 base seeds failed; the tier-4 park and playground on v0.42's seeds and layouts, the street on v0.29 to v0.42's forced set, and the garden on the fourth seed of its search. The five isomorphs are new. The probe pass gave `about_to_trip`, `plant_flowers` and `photo` five pictures each, the pass stratified by angle filled the begging dog at 45, and three park probes were forced for fishing, the first with the windy hat. Every picture was looked at before the screen. All 94 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 404 of 404.
calib: With the reading dog lying down, 42 fields of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, most of all `dog_reading`'s contradiction (s from -0.44 to -0.57) and `cat_stalks_bird`'s inference.
